data_fields.name: burn effect rate (stage advance per tick)
BURN-S damage per stage advance (8.8 fixed point)
BURN-M damage per stage advance (8.8 fixed point)
BURN-L damage per stage advance (8.8 fixed point)

best_idea: Attach an effect to its object by storing its offset from the object's centre and adding the centre back on each read, so fire stays on the same spot as the object moves, while its fractional damage accumulates per advance and whole points go through one damage step.
decision_why: Keep the offset-follow attach and the fraction accumulator as a client-only effect layer; route damage through the engine's one damage step, end effects on game ticks not wall-clock, and give effects no kill credit.
acceptance: Player sees: a burning creature keeps its flame on the same body spot while it moves, and the flame ends on the same game tick on every client; a server test asserts one whole damage point per 256 accumulated fire damage, applied through the engine damage step, with kill credit unchanged by the effect.
